protocol: Mystic Finance (Morpho Vault V2 over standalone Morpho Blue)
note: Mystic 'Core' vaults are Morpho Vault V2 ERC-4626 vaults (adapter-based, NOT MetaMorpho V1 queues). Each vault routes into 3 underlying Morpho Blue markets via a single liquidity adapter. Morpho's hosted API excludes chainId 14, so market state is read directly from Morpho Blue and rates are recomputed from AdaptiveCurveIrm; supply APY headline is cross-checked against DefiLlama yields API.

irm.shape: Piecewise-linear kink at 90% util. Below target, borrow rate scales from rateAtTarget/4 (u=0) up to rateAtTarget (u=90%). Above target it scales up to 4x rateAtTarget at u=100%, and rateAtTarget itself drifts up over time if util stays high (adaptive). Supply APY = borrowAPY * utilization * (1 - marketFee=0). Marginal supply yield to a NEW depositor DROPS as deposit lowers utilization: a deposit of size d into a market with supply S, borrow B moves util from B/S to B/(S+d), so marginal yield falls roughly proportional to util decrease, steeply if you were above 90%.

pairwiseCorrelation.source: ESTIMATE for the risk model. FXRP price-driver = XRP, WFLR = FLR. XRP-FLR correlation ~0.4-0.5 (both crypto-beta, FLR partly an XRP-ecosystem asset). USDT0 stable => ~0 correlation to both. These are yield-relevant price-risk correlations, not APY correlations.
